results.title: ROMANIAN ART WEEK 2026: Dozens of Art Spaces, Galleries and Museums Across Bucharest Open Their Doors for Nine Days - Empower Art & Artists
results.description: Created to strengthen Romania’s contemporary art ecosystem, Romanian Art Week aims to increase the visibility of Romanian artistic practices, encourage international exchange, support the development of the local art market and bring contemporary art closer to new audiences. The 2026 edition takes place in Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca, Timișoara, Oradea and Craiova, bringing together established institutions, commercial galleries, artist-run spaces and independent initiatives.

highlights:
[ROMANIAN ART WEEK 2026: Dozens of Art Spaces, Galleries and Museums Across Bucharest Open Their Doors for Nine Days]

Romanian Art Week is an independent platform dedicated to connecting contemporary art scenes across Romania and strengthening their ties with the international art world.

Taking place from **17–25 October 2026**, Romanian Art Week brings together galleries, museums, artists, independent art spaces, curators, collectors and cultural institutions through a programme of exhibitions, discussions, studio visits and gatherings taking place across the country. The event’s programme is now available at **artweek.ro**.

…

The 2026 edition takes place in Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca, Timișoara, Oradea and Craiova, bringing together established institutions, commercial galleries, artist-run spaces and independent initiatives. In Bucharest, the programme is developed in partnership with three of Romania’s major museums: the National Museum of Art of Romania (MNAR), the Museum of Recent Art (MARe) and the National Museum of Contemporary Art (MNAC).
